en.t: For many days in a row, the rain would not stop.

units.source_text: 匂亲王再度入山之事已经绝望，相思之苦实在难熬。

en.t: Prince Niou had lost all hope of going into the mountains again, and the pain of longing was truly hard to bear.

units.source_text: 他想起“慈亲束我如蚕茧”，叹恨此身太不自由。

en.t: He remembered the line, "A loving parent binds me like a silkworm's cocoon," and lamented how unbearably unfree he was.
It was truly hard on him!

units.source_text: 他就写一封长长的信给浮舟，内有诗曰：

en.t: So he wrote a long letter to Ukifune, and in it included this poem:
